entities.summary: Francisco de Miranda, a notable figure in the history of Venezuela, associated with Bolívar, Independence, and Gran Colombia (1810–1814). Preceded by First Republic. Their legacy influenced Venezuela declares independence — July 5, 1811 and Caracas earthquake devastates patriot cause — March 26, 1812.
